d: Extremely long, flowing pastel pink hair with choppy bangs and two long strands framing the face. Calm, narrow golden-orange eyes on a youthful, mature face. A slender build wearing a white, off-the-shoulder mini dress with a ruffled hem, accented by a black waist corset, black fingerless gloves, and black high-heeled pumps, featuring long crimson ribbons trailing from the waist.
